newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf Gabon details 4-mo net income.
newsitem.headline: Elf Gabon details 4-mo net income.

text.p: Elf Gabon, a 58-percent owned unit of Elf Aquitaine, said on Tuesday it had net income of $206.7 million for the first four months of 1997, of which $50.4 million came from current operations.

The company said in a statement it received $328 million from the liquidation of 65-percent owned unit CPIH, of which $156 million was included in the four-month net income figure. The balance of $171.7 million corresponds to the book value of CPIH shares on Elf Gabon's balance sheet.
Accordingly, the board has decided to pay an interim dividend for the 1997 year of $156.3 million, or $34.73 per share.

Subject to shareholders approval, the total dividend will be $94.64 per share, taking into account $72.89 per share from the CPIH liquidation and the balance on the 1996 dividend of $21.75 which was proposed on February 28.
